newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's Pekao SA group net PLN 284 mln in Jan-May.
newsitem.headline: Poland's Pekao SA group net PLN 284 mln in Jan-May.

text.p: Poland's state-owned Pekao SA and its group of three banks had in the first months of this year a net profit of 284.3 million zlotys and a pre-tax profit of 446.4 million, Pekao said on Wednesday.
It said in a statement the group had a consolidated net profit of 514 million zlotys in the whole of 1996 and a pre-tax profit of 882.1 million zlotys.

Pekao alone, which last year took over state-owned Pomorski Bank Kredytowy SA, Powszechny Bank Gospodarczy SA and Bank Depozytowo- Kredytowy SA, had a 1996 net of 243.4 million zlotys. Unaudited figures released earlier this year showed the group's combined 1997 net at 520.8 million zlotys and Pekao's result at 267.8 million.
Pekao said the group's total assets grew 15.5 percent in the January-May period to 49.22 billion zlotys while shareholder equity increased 20.4 percent to 2.4 billion.

It said the group, created last year under the government's banking consolidation plan, had at the end of 1996 a 20.7 percent share in the total assets of the Polish banking sector and a 11.5 percent share in its combined capital. @
The group's privatisation is due next year, starting with a public offer of up to 15 percent of its shares.
